title: File:Randy Caballero works out.jpg
desc:
11/29/11 - Golden Boy boxer and rising star in the fight world, Randy Caballero, works out in his hometown gym at the Coachella Valley Boxing Club in Coachella, California to prepare for his first title defense Friday, December 2nd at Fantasy Springs Resort Casino.

http://www.fantasyspringsresort.c

title: File:Shields Date Garden, Indio, California (8602634203).jpg
art: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
desc:
My visit to Shields was for one longstanding purpose: to find another great date milkshake. I had enjoyed on in Dateland, Arizona, but every date shake I had tasted since Dateland was a mediocre imposter. Not Shields's date shake though. That was the real deal. It was excellent. 
Shields Date Garden
